snippet.title: The Lone Keeper – Psychological Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
What if you were paid to be alone with your thoughts?

The Lone Keeper is a first-person psychological horror game set on a remote lighthouse island deep in the ocean. You play as a newly hired keeper, responsible for maintaining the light, reporting weather conditions, and ensuring the facility runs smoothly. But as night falls, reality begins to blur — shadows shift, whispers echo, and your own perception becomes your greatest enemy.
